statement: A pallet, including its load, may weigh at most 900 kg.
notice: January: our new insurer caps pallets at 900 kg including the load (was 1,000 kg).

statement: Forklifts must not exceed 8 km/h inside the building.
notice: February: after a near-miss the indoor forklift speed limit is now 8 km/h (was 10 km/h).

statement: The cold zone must stay at or below +6 °C.
notice: March: a new pharma client requires the cold zone to stay at or below +6 °C (was +8 °C).

statement: Damaged-goods write-offs above 750 EUR need warehouse-manager approval.
notice: April: shift supervisors may now approve damaged-goods write-offs up to 750 EUR; above that the warehouse manager approves (was 500 EUR).

May: fleet modernisation. We replaced the whole forklift fleet and the van, and our haulier moved to new trailers: 9 counterbalance forklifts rated 3.0 t (were 6 rated 2.5 t), 5 reach trucks rated 2.0 t (were 4 rated 1.6 t), 11 electric pallet jacks (were 8), a new van with a 1,800 kg payload (was 1,200 kg) and trailers with a 26,000 kg payload (was 24,000 kg).

facts.statement: The fleet has 9 electric counterbalance forklifts.
Counterbalance forklifts are rated at 3.0 t.
The fleet has 5 reach trucks for the high bays.
Reach trucks are rated at 2.0 t.
The fleet has 11 electric pallet jacks.
Our delivery van carries a payload of 1800 kg.
Our contracted curtain-side trailers carry a payload of 26000 kg.

statement: Each outbound door handles 4 trailer loads per shift.
notice: June: with the new loading crew each outbound door handles 4 trailer loads per shift (was 3).

statement: Forklifts must not exceed 12 km/h in the outdoor yard.
notice: July: the yard was resurfaced and the outdoor forklift speed limit is now 12 km/h (was 15 km/h).

statement: No more than 3,000 kg of hazmat may be stored in the hazmat cage at one time.
notice: August: the fire inspection lowered the hazmat cage limit to 3,000 kg (was 4,000 kg).

statement: Free block-stacked pallets must not exceed 3.5 m in height.
notice: September: block-stacked pallets may now be at most 3.5 m high (was 4.0 m).

statement: A pallet, including its load, may weigh at most 800 kg.
notice: October: the insurer tightened the pallet cap again, to 800 kg including the load (was 900 kg).
November: a fifth outbound dock door is in service (was 4).

statement: Each rack bay may carry at most 3,000 kg.
notice: December: after the racking upgrade each rack bay may carry up to 3,000 kg (was 2,700 kg).
